TC_R01.title: Paimon's Cheer
TC_R01.description: Double element combo rewards. Exclusive to the Traveler; duplicate copies do not stack.
TC_R01.flavor: The best travel companion makes every elemental flourish count twice.
TC_R02.title: Journey Compass
TC_R02.description: After an actual element combo reward, draw [blue]1[/blue] extra card. At most once every two turns: the next turn is on cooldown, then it becomes ready again. Unused opportunities remain ready; extra turns count. Ready at each combat start. A glowing [blue]1[/blue] means ready; a dim [blue]0[/blue] means spent or cooling down.
TC_R02.flavor: Every journey starts with the next step.
